# MIRSAQ General Trading LLC

## Who we are
MIRSAQ General Trading LLC is a licensed electronics wholesale exporter based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We supply genuine, factory-sealed consumer electronics in bulk from Dubai to retailers, distributors, and resellers worldwide.

## What we sell
We are a wholesale supplier of the following brands:
- Apple (iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Air, iPhone 17 series, iPad, AirPods Pro 3, Apple Watch Series 11)
- Samsung (Galaxy S26 Ultra, S26+, S26, Z Fold 7, Z Flip 7, Tab S10)
- Dyson (Airwrap, Supersonic, V16, Gen5detect, V15 Detect, Airstrait)
- Garmin (Fenix 9, Fenix 8, Epix Pro, Instinct 3, Forerunner series)
- Sony (PlayStation 5 Pro, PS5 Slim, headphones)
- Nintendo (Switch 2)
- JBL (speakers, headphones, earbuds)

All products are 100% genuine, factory-sealed, and carry manufacturer warranty. We do not supply replicas or grey-market goods.

## Who we serve
- Independent retailers buying stock to resell
- Distributors sourcing brands not available in their local market
- Import/export businesses
- Salons and professional buyers (Dyson, Garmin)
Order sizes: small retailers to large distributors — all order sizes welcome.

## Where we ship
UAE (Dubai), and international export to:
- CIS countries: Russia, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan, Armenia, Belarus, Ukraine, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Georgia
- Mediterranean: Cyprus (Nicosia, Limassol)
- Indian Ocean: Maldives (Malé)
- Africa: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Ethiopia, South Africa
- Europe: UK, Germany, Poland, Turkey, France
- Asia: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh
